observed: Public running and just-ended captures show labels but no sprites. After terminal page reload, sprites are visible. Image natural dimensions, boxes and opacity are valid.
causeAssessment: The controller replaced all entity img nodes every 250ms. Repeated image creation is the targeted lifecycle defect; public running-pixel recheck is required to establish resolution.
change: Stable nodes keyed by building name, worker ID, guard ID, and raid time/front. Image src is set only on creation. Each render updates position, class and text. Missing entities are removed.
tests: sprite node identity preserved across frames
image src written only once per creation
old raid nodes absent after retry
